concept_uz: Tong, Amudaryo boʻyi. Rustam aka boʻri, echki va karamni narigi qirgʻoqqa oʻtkazishi kerak, qayiqqa esa oʻzi va yana bittasi sigʻadi. Ikki marta urinib, ikki marta yutqazadi va tomoshabindan soʻraydi: necha marta? Javob (7) keyingi haftada.
style_line: Cinematic photoreal, warm dawn golden light, soft haze over the water, 35mm film look, muted earth tones with khaki-green river water, gentle Central Asian folk-tale mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of the near bank of the wide silty Amudaryo river in Khorezm at dawn: a sandy landing, tamarisk bushes, tugai poplars, a mud-brick farmhouse wall, a wooden tethering post, a small old wooden rowboat with a faded blue stripe pulled up on the sand, mist on the water, and on the far bank the faint domes of an old town. No people, no animals.

Vertical 9:16 full-body portrait of an Uzbek farmer from Khorezm, about 50, kind weathered face, short grey-black beard, tall shaggy white sheepskin hat (chugirma), striped quilted chapan robe with a cloth belt, leather boots, standing on a sandy riverbank at dawn with one hand on a small wooden rowboat. Eye-level camera, river softly blurred behind.
Vertical 9:16 close portrait of one small white goat with a brown patch over its LEFT eye and a small copper bell on a red string, cheeky expression, mid-chew, standing on sand by a river at dawn.
Vertical 9:16 portrait of one lean grey steppe wolf with yellow eyes, a thick old rope tied loosely round its neck as a leash, lying calm but watchful on sand by a river at dawn.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 shot of the same riverbank at dawn: the farmer standing by the rowboat; the wolf on its rope tied to the post; the goat a few metres away; one green cabbage in a willow basket on the sand beside the goat. Exactly one of each animal. Same faces, same light.

Change the scene: the rowboat is now in the middle of the river, filmed from the far side. The farmer rows toward the camera with the wolf sitting in the bow. Behind them, small on the near bank, the goat stands next to the cabbage basket. Same faces, same light, 9:16.

Change the scene: the rowboat is now in the middle of the river, filmed from the far side. The farmer rows toward the camera with the cabbage basket in the bow. Behind them, small on the near bank, the wolf on its rope and the goat. Same faces, same light, 9:16.

lines.text: Bozor narigi qirgʻoqda. Qayigʻim esa kichkina…

scenes.prompt: Slow drone push-in from high above the misty river down to the farmer on the bank, who looks at the tiny boat, then at the wolf, the goat and the cabbage, and sighs. Audio: wind, river, a distant bird, the goat's bell. The farmer says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly husky middle-aged Uzbek male voice: "Bozor narigi qirg'oqda. Qayig'im esa kichkina..." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Faqat men va yana bittasi sigʻadi.

scenes.prompt: Medium shot. The farmer steps one foot into the small wooden rowboat; it rocks and sinks low, he grabs the side and lets out a small amused laugh. Audio: wood creak, water slapping the hull. He says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly husky middle-aged Uzbek male voice, shaking his head: "Faqat men va yana bittasi sig'adi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Men yoʻgʻimda boʻri echkini yeydi… echki esa karamni.

scenes.prompt: Slow push-in on the wolf staring at the goat; the goat stops chewing and freezes, then slowly turns its head toward a cabbage basket and licks its lips. Comic timing. No attack. Audio: the bell goes silent, a low rumble from the wolf, a tiny bleat. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly husky middle-aged Uzbek male voice: "Men yo'g'imda bo'ri echkini yeydi... echki esa karamni." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The farmer rows calmly, glances back over his shoulder, sees the goat leaning into the cabbage basket on the near bank, and freezes mid-stroke with wide eyes. The wolf in the bow looks back too. Audio: oars, a faint crunch of leaves, the oars stop. He shouts in Uzbek with a warm, slightly husky middle-aged Uzbek male voice, alarmed: "Voy! Karamim!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The farmer rows with the cabbage basket, glances back and sees the wolf on the near bank rise and take one slow step toward the goat, who freezes. Cut on the farmer's face dropping. No attack. Audio: oars, a low growl, one panicked bell ring. He cries in Uzbek with a warm, slightly husky middle-aged Uzbek male voice: "Yo'q-yo'q, echkim!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Xoʻsh, siz qanday qilasiz? Eng kamida necha marta oʻtishim kerak? Javobni izohda yozing!

scenes.prompt: Medium close-up: the farmer by the beached boat scratches under his tall sheepskin hat, then looks straight into the camera with a half-smile, asking the viewer for help. Hold on the look at the end. Audio: river ambience, one bell ring. He says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly husky middle-aged Uzbek male voice, friendly and curious: "Xo'sh, siz qanday qilasiz? Eng kamida necha marta o'tishim kerak? Javobni izohda yozing!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

post_text_uz: Boʻri, echki va karam. Qayiqqa dehqon va yana bittasi sigʻadi. Eng kamida necha marta oʻtish kerak? Javobingizni izohda yozing — toʻgʻri javob keyingi hafta! #mantiq #jumboq #Amudaryo #Powerty
